notes: v2.132 (2026-11-24, afternoon run): 131st tower 'Gingerbread' (a gingerbread person — round head over a neck, wide arms, body, and two legs — a gingerbread silhouette to demolish, 25 blocks, 5 clusters sizes 8/3/10/2/2, all 4 colours, no singletons, 0 canonical duplicates) + 128th co-play prompt (decorate a paper gingerbread friend together — stick big stickers or large buttons saying 'stick… stick!', sniff a small bowl of cinnamon saying 'sniff… sniff… yummy!', run around the room saying 'run, run, as fast as you can!'; a grown-up holds the spice bowl, big stickers and large buttons only, and a real gingerbread cookie is for tasting only if the family already knows it is safe). Gingerbread research: the smell is the hook — cinnamon/ginger in a small bowl, 'sniff, sniff, yummy!' — and decorating a paper gingerbread person with big stickers/buttons/pom-poms is the canonical 2-year-old fine-motor craft (peel, press, push); the story's 'run, run, as fast as you can!' gives a gross-motor chase form.
